Sixth correction pass for ARCADE-GODOT-PILOT-GAME-001 in web688/4444555.xyz. This is a controller review correction of current PR #31 head 5120f74947d8a0d5cd1b9cd4b2694b118c8e6f68. Read .ai-factory/session.json, AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW.md, docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 3, README.md, docs/GAME_SDK.md, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/OWNER_PREVIEW_GATE.md, .ai-factory/PILOT.md, the PR #31 owner comments, and the complete current Pulse Loom implementation. Work only on existing branch phase/godot-pilot-pulse-loom from exact current head 5120f74947d8a0d5cd1b9cd4b2694b118c8e6f68. Do not change main or factory/control, do not touch Hullwatch/PR #29, do not open or merge another PR, and do not ask the owner routine questions.

Controller review found a concrete acceptance blocker in the fifth correction. Constants define SQUARE as lane 3 with emerald/green color and CIRCLE as lane 4 with crimson/red color. However games/pulse-loom/scripts/game_manager.gd currently makes the third assisted pulse target_lane = 4 while its comment calls that "Square □"; tests/pulse-loom.test.mjs repeats the same incorrect assumption ({src:4,tgt:4} // Square □). The headless onboarding test also accepts target_lane 4 for that guided pulse. This means the correction intended to exercise the green square actually exercises the crimson circle, and the tests codify the mismatch instead of detecting it. This directly matches the owner's playtest suspicion around the green square and crimson/red symbol. Do not merge or treat 5120f749... as owner-ready.

Required correction:
1) Preserve the canonical global lane/glyph mapping in constants.gd unless evidence shows it is wrong: lane 3 = SQUARE □ = emerald/green; lane 4 = CIRCLE ○ = crimson/red. Do not swap global glyph indices just to make the mistaken onboarding test pass.
2) Remove the possibility of assisted-pulse metadata drifting from comments/tests. Define the 3 assisted pulse specs in one authoritative runtime helper/data source and make _spawn_assisted_pulse consume it. Tests should derive/assert against that runtime definition where practical rather than duplicating mislabeled literals.
3) Make the guided sequence deliberately exercise both owner-suspect targets. Keep three guided pulses and include an explicit GREEN SQUARE (target lane 3) and an explicit CRIMSON CIRCLE (target lane 4), plus one other simple first pulse. Choose source lanes so square and circle require different non-zero rotor orientations and are easy to distinguish. Guidance text must obtain glyph name/symbol from constants using target_lane.
4) Add a deterministic headless regression for repeated target occurrences. For EVERY target lane 0..5, exercise at least two occurrences from different source lanes. For each occurrence prove all of these agree: SignalPulse.target_lane (displayed target glyph identity), radar_lanes.active_target_lane (highlighted target terminal), signal_core.active_target_lane, PulseLoomRouting.get_required_step, PulseLoomRouting.get_routed_lane preview destination, PulseLoomRouting.is_aligned, and the actual gameplay resolution result. Give special explicit assertions for lane 3 SQUARE/□/emerald and lane 4 CIRCLE/○/crimson. The second occurrence must not inherit stale target/highlight state from the first.
5) Verify preview state is refreshed when the nearest active pulse changes after a resolution/miss and when a repeated target returns. If a stale-state bug exists in set_preview_state/set_preview_pulse/_update_preview_state, fix it narrowly.
6) Correct the Node onboarding behavioral test so it no longer labels target 4 as Square. Add a regression model for repeated square and crimson target occurrences if it materially complements the Godot behavioral test; do not use source-substring assertions.
7) Preserve the fifth correction's route helper, through-core/outbound preview, aligned double-ring/lock vs misaligned route marker, onboarding clock hold, retry-on-guided-miss behavior, score/multiplier/three-overload semantics, deterministic seed, SDK/RunTicket strictness, exact-origin/source checks, visibility pause, export policy, and portal integration.
8) Re-run all previously passing strict timestamp, web-bridge typing, ticket, daily-seed, host lifecycle, export, and integration tests.

Verification required before PASS: npm run verify; explicit Godot headless smoke with the new repeated-target/glyph/highlight regression; clean single-threaded Godot 4.6.3 Web export after deleting generated Pulse Loom output; verify index.html/index.js/index.wasm/index.pck non-empty; production dist and --base=/test/ dist both contain all four artifacts; behavioral Node tests pass; git status proves generated exports and .ai-factory remain ignored/untracked. Commit and push the correction to phase/godot-pilot-pulse-loom. Before exit write .ai-factory/result.json with exact commands/outcomes, the corrected assisted sequence including lane/name/symbol/color identities, repeated-occurrence regression evidence, artifact sizes, git-status evidence, and pushed HEAD. Otherwise report FAIL, BLOCKED, or NEEDS_CONTROLLER.
